audit_items.proof_trace: The invariant totalRequired == allocatedTokens + legionFeeOnTokens + referrerFeeOnTokens is enforced by construction: lines 96-103 verify that the caller-provided legionFee and referrerFee equal exactly (bps * amount) / 10000 (reverting otherwise), then three sequential safeTransferFrom calls pull amount to the distributor, legionFee to the Legion receiver, and referrerFee to the referrer receiver. The total pulled from msg.sender is definitionally amount + legionFee + referrerFee, making the assertion a mathematical identity that cannot be violated. All three implementations (LegionTokenDistributor, LegionAbstractSale, LegionPreLiquidApprovedSale) follow the identical pattern and are each guarded by onlyProject and a one-time tokensSupplied flag.
